title: Voyager 1 reaches one light day on the abduction anniversary

tellings.quote: In fact, this year, 2026, on November 18th, at 3:16 a.m. Mountain time, exactly 49 years from the time Mario and Michael were blacked out aboard a spacecraft, Voyager 1 will be exactly one full light day away from Earth.

plain: Michels points out that on November 18, 2026, at 3:16 a.m. Mountain time, the space probe Voyager 1 will be exactly one light day from Earth, that is, as far as light travels in a day. He says this falls exactly 49 years after two Air Force veterans, whom the episode calls Mario and Michael, say they blacked out aboard a spacecraft in 1977. He offers the coincidence himself, in a 2026 episode reuniting the two men, as a striking echo of their abduction.
